description: This file contains functions and script setup for configuring and managing DHCPv6 protocol, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown processes within a network configuration environment.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 protocol configuration by adding various configuration options and parameters.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to a given list or string representing DHCPv6 prefixes.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds DHCPv6 send options to the current configuration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up DHCPv6 configuration for a specified interface, constructing command options and exporting environment variables.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Triggers a renewal of DHCPv6 lease for a given interface using SIGUSR1 signal.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Terminates DHCPv6 lease and configuration for a specified interface.
